family: Aftermarket 1-DIN with a small segment LCD
one_liner: A perfectly good box and cage behind a window that is the wrong shape and too small.

price.why: The cheapest and most plentiful category by a distance.

window_w_mm.why: Typically around a third of the fascia. Measure.

window_h_mm.why: Usually too short for a 256×64 panel.

chassis.v: steel, ISO 7736, often shallower than the CD-era units
chassis.why: Mechless units are shallow, which can help in a tight dash and hurts nowhere.

display_tech.v: segment or small dot LCD, backlit
display_tech.why: No inverter, so this is the SAFEST category to gut.

why: Cheapest way to a chassis, a cage and a trim ring.
No CD laser and no VFD inverter on a mechless unit — nothing in it is dangerous.
Often shallower, which matters in a car with no room behind the dash.
watch_out: ⚠️ The window will need enlarging, and a cut fascia is why home-built decks look home-built. Be honest about your ability to file a straight line before choosing this.
Some very cheap units have a plastic chassis. Check for steel.
Glued rather than clipped fascias appear at the bottom of the market and do not come off intact.
steps: Same teardown as any 1-DIN unit — fascia first, keep the screws.
Decide honestly whether you are enlarging the window or replacing the face with acrylic. Both are fine; doing half of each is not.
If enlarging: mark from the PANEL, not from a measurement, and cut undersize then file to the line. Acrylic behind it hides a multitude.
If replacing: use the fascia only as a template for the clip positions and cut a new face from 3 mm acrylic.

models.name: Sony CDX-GT / MEX series, later units
models.note: Enormous numbers made, worthless broken, and a perfectly good steel box with a cage. The window is the problem, not the unit.

models.name: Pioneer DEH-1000 / DEH-2000 series
models.note: Pioneer's budget line. The cheapest route to a chassis and cage in this entire document.

models.name: Kenwood KDC-100 / KDC-200 series
models.note: As above. Mechless variants are shallower, which helps in a tight dash.

models.name: JVC KD-R series
models.note: Common and cheap. Check the fascia is clipped rather than glued.

models.name: Any 'mechless' Bluetooth/USB 1-DIN receiver
models.note: ✅ The SAFEST donor of all — no CD laser, no VFD inverter, nothing charged. Shallow too. You are just going to cut the window.

teardown.note: Often clipped; ⚠️ at the bottom of the market they are glued and will not come off intact.
Fewer switches than the dot-matrix units. Count them before you rely on six.
Segment LCD — backlit, no inverter. Nothing charged.
A mechless unit has none, which is why it is the safest thing here.
⚠️ Check it is steel. The very cheapest units are plastic.
